profile.name: Bhavya Kakani
profile.title: Business Systems Analyst | QA Analyst
profile.bio: Results-driven analyst with 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, business requirements, testing, and release delivery across healthcare, operations, and corporate environments. Skilled in translating stakeholder needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and test scenarios that improve delivery outcomes. Proven success reducing defects, improving release readiness, strengthening data accuracy, and streamlining workflows through effective system enhancements. Hands-on expertise with SQL, Jira, Excel, Power BI, UAT, regression testing, BRD/FRD documentation, and Agile methodologies. Recognized for strong communication, stakeholder coordination, quick learning, and reliable execution across cross-functional teams.
